Corded Fabric and Tufted Craft: Corded fabric has a soft and delicate touch, with good breathability and wear resistance. The unique tufted process not only enhances the firmness of the fabric, but also adds a touch of retro and fashionable feeling to the overall design

items.label: Design
items.value: Designed with pocket coils and high-density foam cushions, our Triton couch is the right mix of luxury and comfort- making it the favorite go to spot in any home.

items: Fabric, solid wood frame, breathable and stable. High-density foam and internal spring-filled cushions provide comfort and durability

items.label: Reversible Ottoman
items.value: The ottoman can be moved and freely DIY, enabling a multi-functional recliner design that provides maximum comfort. Individual ottoman can be installed any seat according to your preference. The L-shaped combination accommodates the corner wall and provides more seating space

items.label: Suitable for Many Occasions
items.value: This sectional sofa can be well integrated into different scenes, is the great choice to decorate your living room, office, apartment, providing excellent space for relaxing and entertainment

items.label: Elastic Comfort Support
items.value: This boneless sofa is filled with high-density foam and shredded foam, combining elastic support structure and soft comfort. Two pillows can provide additional waist or neck support, giving you a fully customizable leisure experience

items.label: Effortless Setup
items.value: The folding sofa is pre filled, you don't need to fill it yourself, just unfold, tap and shake to restore the compressed elasticity, wait for about 48 hours to return to its original shape and enjoy!
